unquantified_components: PBE0/def2-SVP + CPCM systematic error on an absolute ionisation free energy of a cation. A def2-TZVP single point exists for the cation only, with no neutral counterpart, so the basis effect on this couple cannot be measured in this workspace.

Transfer from the SMe/PMe3 model to the real 2,6-dimethylbenzenethiolate/dmpe compound. An aryl thiolate is a weaker donor than an alkyl thiolate and should shift the couple positive; nothing here bounds that shift.
